source_text: Ossa Ioseph quae tulerant ex Aegypto sepelierunt in Sichem — promissio iurata impletur. Spes resurrectionis in terra promissionis.
pass_a_gloss: Bones of-Joseph which they-had-carried from Egypt they-buried in Shechem — promise sworn is-fulfilled. Hope of-resurrection in land of-promise.
pass_b_english: [[Joseph’s bones brought up from Egypt are buried at Shechem >> Bible:Joshua 24:32]] — the sworn promise fulfilled. Resurrection hope in the land of promise.
